metaDescription: Convert times between 12-hour AM/PM and 24-hour military format, including 2400, noon and midnight, for a whole list at once.
intro: Switch between 3:45 PM and 15:45 (or 1545) for many times in one go.
why:
Paste times one per line in forms such as 3:45 PM, 0800, 17:30 or 23:59:30. The converter shows the 24-hour time and the four-digit military form for AM/PM inputs, and the AM/PM time for 24-hour inputs, and flags invalid entries. 12:00 AM is 00:00 and 12:00 PM is 12:00.

Military time is simply the 24-hour clock written without a colon. 2400 means the end of a day and is normally written 0000 for the next day.

No data is sent anywhere: the work happens in your browser, so you can use it offline once the page has loaded.

faq.a: No. Everything is processed in your browser, and the page makes no network requests with your input.
